run_reward_training: run reward model training with a specified dataset and model configuration
build_reward_trainer: build a RewardTrainer instance with model, datasets, and PEFT configuration for reward modeling
create_reward_parser: create an argparse parser for the reward training CLI with dataclass argument types
load_reward_dataset: load a dataset for reward training from HuggingFace Hub or a local dataset mixture
save_reward_model: save a trained reward model to disk and optionally push it to the HuggingFace Hub
